content.text: Become a member today!Click here for more information Palm Springs International Film Society THE SINGERS Directed by Sam Davis USA | 18 minutes | California Premiere | FACE THE MUSIC ShortFest 2025 Archive About ShortFest Shorts Programs Film Finder How to Attend Passes & Tickets Sponsors ShortFest Awards & Jury ShortFest Awards A lowly pub full of downtrodden patrons unexpectedly connects through an impromptu sing-off. Featuring viral video singing talents and unique personalities from the internet’s unlikeliest corners, this experimental docu-musical hybrid is crafted like an improvisational play. film details Director: Sam Davis Producers: Jack Piatt, David Breschel, Charlie Cohen, Sam Davis Cinematographers: Sam Davis Editor: Sam Davis Music: Mike Young, Will Harrington, Chris Smither, Judah Kelly, Matthew Corcoran Cast: Mike Young, Will Harrington, Chris Smither, Judah Kelly, Matthew Corcoran Country: USA Language: English Year: 2025 Running Time: 18 minutes Premiere Status: California Premiere Primary Company: Highway West Contact Email: David@highwaywestent.com Website: highwaywestent.com Screening in: FACE THE MUSIC Be it through instruments, dance, or playlists, these shorts explore the role music plays in our lives, our memories, and our imaginations.
